title.zh-TW: 前後對比滑桿拖曳比較

summary.zh-TW: 兩張畫面疊在一起（線框稿和完成稿），拖曳中間的分隔線比較前後差異；點畫面任何地方，分隔線會滑過去；鍵盤方向鍵、Home／End 也能移動。整個效果只用 transform，不改寬度也不用 clip-path。
summary.en: Two screens stacked (wireframe and final), compared by dragging the divider. Clicking anywhere slides it there; arrow keys and Home / End move it too. The whole effect uses transform only, no width changes or clip-path.

text.zh-TW: 裁切的做法：After 的外層往右推 p、裡面的內容往左推一樣多，內容看起來不動，只有左邊被外層的 overflow: hidden 切掉。比改寬度（每格重排版面）或 clip-path（每格重畫裁切）都輕。
text.en: The clipping trick: the After wrapper moves right by p and its content moves left by the same amount, so the content stays put while overflow: hidden cuts off the left. Lighter than changing width (layout every frame) or clip-path (repainting the clip).

text.zh-TW: 拖的是分隔線本身，但 trigger 設成整個畫面：按在任何地方都能直接開始拖，不必精準抓到把手。
text.en: The divider is what moves, but trigger is the whole picture: you can start dragging from anywhere instead of hunting for the handle.

text.zh-TW: 按下的那一刻，分隔線先用補間滑到手指的位置；真的開始拖時（onDragStart）停掉補間、this.update() 讓 Draggable 從目前位置接著算，兩邊才不會互搶。
text.en: On press the divider tweens to the pointer; once a real drag starts (onDragStart) the tween is killed and this.update() lets Draggable continue from the current spot, so they don't fight.

text.zh-TW: 分隔線是一個滑桿：可以 Tab 到、方向鍵移動、Home／End 到兩端，讀屏唸「30% before, 70% after」。
text.en: The divider is a slider: tabbable, moved with arrow keys, Home / End jump to the ends, and screen readers hear “30% before, 70% after”.

text.zh-TW: 手機上上下滑仍然是捲動頁面，只有左右拖才是拖分隔線；寬度改變時用比例重新換算位置，並更新拖曳範圍。
text.en: On phones a vertical swipe still scrolls the page and only a horizontal drag moves the divider. When the width changes the position is recomputed from the ratio and the drag bounds updated.
